summary: SurgePays filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement updating the sales agent under its existing $15M at-the-market offering. The ATM agreement with Titan Partners Group LLC, dated August 5, 2025, was assigned on October 6, 2026 to Titan Partners Securities LLC with the company's consent. No new securities terms, price, or size were disclosed. Offers following the assignment will be made through or to Titan Partners Securities. This is a routine shelf takedown mechanics update, not a special situation; no board recommendation or advisor is named. Watch for ATM share sales and potential dilution.
